set -euo pipefail; export DISPLAY=${DISPLAY:-:0}; echo MACHINE_ID=ai-core-node; echo OWNER=gabriel; echo BEGIN_EXACT_CHROME_APP_PROCESSES; python3 - <<'PY'
import os, pathlib
needle='--app=http://127.0.0.1:8788/'
for p in pathlib.Path('/proc').iterdir():
    if not p.name.isdigit(): continue
    try:
        raw=(p/'cmdline').read_bytes().split(b'\0')
    except Exception:
        continue
    args=[x.decode('utf-8','replace') for x in raw if x]
    if not args: continue
    exe=os.path.basename(args[0])
    if exe in ('chrome','google-chrome','chromium','chromium-browser') and needle in args:
        print('PID='+p.name+' ARGC='+str(len(args))+' ARGS='+repr(args))
PY
echo END_EXACT_CHROME_APP_PROCESSES; echo BEGIN_TITLE_WINDOWS; IDS=$(xdotool search --name '^FranKenstein -- live$' 2>/dev/null || true); for W in $IDS; do echo WINDOW_ID_DEC=$W; printf 'WINDOW_ID_HEX=0x%x\n' "$W"; xdotool getwindowgeometry --shell "$W" 2>/dev/null || true; echo XPROP_BEGIN; xprop -id "$W" _NET_WM_PID WM_CLASS WM_NAME _NET_WM_NAME _NET_WM_STATE _NET_WM_DESKTOP 2>/dev/null || true; echo XPROP_END; echo XWININFO_BEGIN; xwininfo -id "$W" 2>/dev/null | grep -E 'Window id:|Map State:|Override Redirect State:|Absolute upper-left X:|Absolute upper-left Y:|Width:|Height:' || true; echo XWININFO_END; done; echo END_TITLE_WINDOWS; echo BEGIN_WMCTRL_EXACT; wmctrl -lpGx | grep -F 'FranKenstein -- live' || true; echo END_WMCTRL_EXACT; echo LIVE_SHA256=$(sha256sum /home/ai-core-node/.claude/star/visual/buehne.html|awk '{print $1}'); echo WINDOW_IDENTITY_ANOMALY_READBACK=PASS; echo SCOPE=READ_ONLY_WINDOW_IDENTITY_MAP_STATE_PID_CLASS_GEOMETRY_NO_RELOAD_NO_BROWSER_SPAWN_NO_LIVE_MUTATION
